integrity: Analytic generator-moment proof; numerical and rational checks supplement rather than replace the all-parameter proof; full-text priority comparison for one broad resetting source remains inaccessible, so no claim of independently established priority.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies stationary variance of squared position (harmonic energy), not position variance; assumes canonical radial/Bessel zero behavior, fixed positive reset site, independent Poisson resetting and positive parameters; general reset distributions and arbitrary boundaries are unproved.
title: A two-wing variance-overshoot transition under logarithmic-harmonic resetting
